<!--
This repository is maintained in a low-activity mode. Issues are triaged by the
stewards on a best-effort basis; there is no schedule.

Good issues here:

- A specification says something that is wrong, or that contradicts the test
  fixtures or what interoperable implementations do. Say which spec and which
  section, and what the correct behaviour is. A pull request with the fix is
  even better.
- Something that implementations rely on is not written down.

Proposals to change or extend a protocol are not issues: open a pull request
with an IPIP instead. See https://specs.ipfs.tech/meta/ipip-process/

Questions and support requests belong on https://discuss.ipfs.tech

(you can delete this section after reading)
-->
